Nyzhnyodniprovsk (Now Part of Dnipro city) Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Dnipropetrovs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Nyzhnyodniprovs'k — now absorbed into the city of Dnipro — was home to a Jewish community from the second half of the 19th century, served from 1899 by Rabbi N. T. Berenshtein and supporting, by 1910, three synagogues and two cemeteries; its Jewish population grew to 3,360 by that year, though its share of the town's total fell as the town itself expanded. Those who could not escape before the German occupation of August 1941 were murdered. According to ethnographer Valentyn Starostin, this cemetery once had a chevra kadisha (burial society) operating on-site; it has since been completely destroyed and overbuilt with a park, with no gravestones remaining.
